newsitem.title: USA: Federal-Mogul CEO recovering from surgery.
newsitem.headline: Federal-Mogul CEO recovering from surgery.

text.p: Federal-Mogul Corp said Monday that Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Dennis Gormley was recovering from successful coronary bypass surgery.

Gormley, 56, underwent non-emergency surgery on August 20 at a Detroit hospital. He elected to have the surgery after an artery blockage was detected during a routine annual stress test, the company said.

Federal-Mogul said Gormley was expected to be back at the company's headquarters within a month. The company makes a broad line of parts for light vehicles, heavy trucks and farm and construction vehicles.
